pages.text: Finish your Tier 4 set before stepping into these arenas — this is the hardest content in the pack. Deep Aether, the End, and the Ultimate Bosses all punish under-preparation.

$(bold)Ender Dragon$() — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Waking Lichblade$(/l) (25% — highest in the pack), Dragon Heart, Dragon Scale. Scales progressively.$(br2)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses: Sorcerer$() — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Mjolnir$(/l) (20%), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses: Storm$() — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Storm's Edge$(/l) (20%), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Botania Gaia Guardian$() — Summoned Botania capstone. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiblade$(/l) (20%), Gaia Spirit Fragment. Scales progressively.

$(bold)Deep Aether Boss$() — EOTS Controller. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Flamewind$(/l) (18%), T4 boss materials.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss$() — 6 bosses across The Abyss: The Other Side, each carrying its own unique.$(br2)$(bold)Stalwart Dungeons T3+$() — Shelterer, Nether Keeper, Awful Ghast.$(br2)$(bold)Next: start with the Ender Dragon — best unique odds in the pack, and Terramity's relocated Virtue and Sorceress Circe wait beyond.$()
